sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 460. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 360. Deal magic damage (Wind) 3 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 140. Applies Beguilement for 40 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic attack Ability Power by 100 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Boosts critical hit Ability Power by 100 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic Ability Power and Critical Assault buff limits by 50 for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 60000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 60000
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases the Ability Power of the 460-Ability-Power attack that deals magic wind damage to all enemies 5 times with a success rate of 100 by 500.

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 120 seconds.

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Fortify 25% for 120 seconds (when physical or magic damage exceeds a percentage of max HP equal to this effect's value, the total damage is instead converted into fixed damage equal to the same percentage of max HP. This effect reduces by 10 seconds each time it is triggered).
Only [Velvet Room Resident] Margaret can be used as Unlocking Potential material
